description.value:
The Sidewinder is the younger – but wiser – brother to the Copperhead. Based on the same frame, Nokota engineers finally crafted their own Smart-class rifle. But to say this gun is truly "smart" is a certain overreach. The Sidewinder doesn't try to hide what it is, and it's clear it can't stand toe to toe with its counterparts from Arasaka, Militech and Kang Tao. Yes, it offers aim-assist, but anyone who's ever wielded a true top-shelf smart rifle can tell you the difference in quality is obvious.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Carbine Barrel, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: None

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Carbine Barrel, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
